phrases.latin: «Satis est,» inquit. «Siste aquam.» Puer epitonium ipse clausit.
phrases.english: “That’s enough,” he said. “Turn the water off.” The boy turned the tap off himself.

taps.html: Not Traupman’s versāre / reversāre (Traupman 123); reversāre is Late Latin. A house ruling.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 123.
